     2|#
     3|# Uses `npx expo run:ios` which handles ALL the complexity:
     4|#   - Expo prebuild (generates native iOS project)
     5|#   - CocoaPods install
     6|#   - xcodebuild with CORRECT flags (no manual flag guessing)
     7|#   - Boots a simulator
     8|#   - Installs the app
     9|#   - Launches the app
    10|#
    11|# Then we capture screenshots and run Maestro flows.
    12|#
    13|# Triggers:
    14|#   - Push to main (when chat files, Maestro flows, or this workflow change)
    15|#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI
    16|#
    17|# Secrets required (already configured in repo):
    18|#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
    19|#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
    20|#
    21|# Secret required for full 20-step chat QA (owner must add):
    22|#   - OWNER_PASSWORD — owner's Supabase password for app login
    23|
    24|name: iOS Simulator QA
    25|
    26|on:
    27|  push:
    28|    branches: [main]
    29|    paths:
    30|      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
    31|      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
    32|      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
    33|      - 'expo/eas.json'
    34|      - 'expo/app.config.ts'
    35|      - 'expo/package.json'
    36|      - 'expo/assets/images/**'
    37|      - 'expo/plugins/**'
    38|      - '.github/workflows/ios-simulator-qa.yml'
    39|  workflow_dispatch:
    40|    inputs:
    41|      run_full_qa:
    42|        description: 'Run full 20-step chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
    43|        required: false
    44|        default: false
    45|        type: boolean
    46|
    47|env:
    48|  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
    49|  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
    50|  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
    51|  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
    52|  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com
    53|
    54|permissions:
    55|  contents: read
    56|  issues: write
    57|
    58|jobs:
    59|  build-and-test:
    60|    name: iOS Simulator Build + Maestro QA
    61|    runs-on: macos-latest
    62|    timeout-minutes: 60
    63|    outputs:
    64|      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
    65|      app_path: ${{ steps.app.outputs.path }}
    66|      simulator_id: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_id }}
    67|      simulator_name: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_name }}
    68|      ios_version: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.ios_version }}
    69|      maestro_launch_result: ${{ steps.maestro-launch.outcome }}
    70|      maestro_chat_result: ${{ steps.maestro-chat.outcome }}
    71|
    72|    steps:
    73|      - name: Checkout code
    74|        uses: actions/checkout@v4
    75|        with:
    76|          fetch-depth: 1
    77|
    78|      - name: Setup Bun
    79|        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
    80|
    81|      - name: Install root dependencies
    82|        run: bun install
    83|
    84|      - name: Install Expo dependencies
    85|        working-directory: expo
    86|        run: bun install
    87|
    88|      - name: Verify Expo CLI
    89|        working-directory: expo
    90|        run: |
    91|          echo "=== Node version ==="
    92|          node --version
    93|          echo "=== Expo CLI version ==="
    94|          npx expo --version
    95|          echo "=== Expo package version ==="
    96|          node -e "console.log('expo:', require('expo/package.json').version)"
    97|          echo "=== expo-router version ==="
    98|          node -e "console.log('expo-router:', require('expo-router/package.json').version)" 2>&1 || echo "expo-router NOT FOUND"
    99|
   100|      # ============================================================
   101|      # KEY FIX: Use `npx expo run:ios` instead of manual xcodebuild.
   102|      # Expo's CLI knows the correct xcodebuild flags, destination,
   103|      # and build settings. Manual xcodebuild was producing exit 0
   104|      # with no .app bundle because of incorrect -destination flags.
   105|      # `expo run:ios` handles: prebuild → pod install → xcodebuild
   106|      # → boot simulator → install app → launch app — all in one.
   107|      # ============================================================
   108|      - name: Build and run on iOS Simulator (expo run:ios)
   109|        id: build
   110|        working-directory: expo
   111|        timeout-minutes: 45
   112|        run: |
   113|          set -o pipefail
   114|          echo "=== Starting expo run:ios ==="
   115|          echo "This handles prebuild + pods + xcodebuild + install + launch"
   116|          npx expo run:ios --configuration debug 2>&1 | tee expo-build.log
   117|          BUILD_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
   118|          echo "=== expo run:ios exit code: $BUILD_EXIT ==="
   119|          echo "build_exit=$BUILD_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   120|          if [ "$BUILD_EXIT" -eq 0 ]; then
   121|            echo "build_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   122|            echo "Build + install + launch completed successfully"
   123|          else
   124|            echo "build_status=failed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   125|            echo "=== BUILD FAILED — last 200 lines ==="
   126|            tail -200 expo-build.log
   127|            echo "### Build Failure — Last 200 Lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   128|            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   129|            tail -200 expo-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   130|            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   131|          fi
   132|        env:
   133|          EXPO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
   134|
   135|      - name: Check build result
   136|        working-directory: expo
   137|        if: steps.build.outputs.build_status != 'success'
   138|        env:
   139|          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
   140|        run: |
   141|          echo "::error::expo run:ios failed. Creating diagnostic issue with build log."
   142|          # Post the full build log as a GitHub issue so we can see
   143|          # the actual error without admin access to Actions logs.
   144|          {
   145|            echo "## iOS Simulator QA Build Diagnostics"
   146|            echo ""
   147|            echo "**Commit:** ${GITHUB_SHA}"
   148|            echo "**Run:** ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
   149|            echo ""
   150|            echo "### expo run:ios output (last 800 lines)"
   151|            echo '```'
   152|            tail -800 expo-build.log 2>/dev/null || echo "not found"
   153|            echo '```'
   154|            echo ""
   155|            echo "### Error lines extracted"
   156|            echo '```'
   157|            grep -i -n 'error:\|fatal\|failed\|cannot\|not found\|** build\|consteval\|xcodebuild exited\|CommandError' expo-build.log 2>/dev/null | tail -60 || echo "no error lines found"
   158|            echo '```'
   159|          } > diagnostic-body.md
   160|          gh label create "ios-qa-diagnostic" --color "FBCA04" 2>/dev/null || true
   161|          gh issue create \
   162|            --title "iOS QA Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}" \
   163|            --body-file diagnostic-body.md \
   164|            --label "ios-qa-diagnostic" 2>&1 || \
   165|          gh issue create --title "iOS QA Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}" --body-file diagnostic-body.md 2>&1 || true
   166|          exit 1
   167|
   168|      # ============================================================
   169|      # Find the .app bundle that expo run:ios built.
   170|      # expo run:ios builds to ios/build/ or ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/
   171|      # ============================================================
   172|      - name: Find built .app bundle
   173|        id: app
   174|        working-directory: expo
   175|        run: |
   176|          echo "=== Searching for .app bundle ==="
   177|          # Search multiple possible build output locations
   178|          APP_PATH=$(find ios/build -name "*.app" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -1)
   179|          if [ -z "$APP_PATH" ]; then
   180|            APP_PATH=$(find ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData -name "*.app" -type d -path "*Debug-iphonesimulator*" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
   181|          fi
   182|          if [ -z "$APP_PATH" ]; then
   183|            APP_PATH=$(find /Users/runner/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData -name "*.app" -type d -path "*iphonesimulator*" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
   184|          fi
   185|          if [ -z "$APP_PATH" ]; then
   186|            echo "::error::No .app bundle found anywhere"
   187|            echo "=== Searching all of DerivedData ==="
   188|            find ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData -name "*.app" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20
   189|            find /Users/runner/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData -name "*.app" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20
   190|            echo "=== Searching ios/build ==="
   191|            find ios/build -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20
   192|            exit 1
   193|          fi
   194|          APP_PATH_ABS="$(cd "$(dirname "$APP_PATH")" && pwd)/$(basename "$APP_PATH")"
   195|          echo "path=$APP_PATH_ABS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   196|          echo "App bundle found: $APP_PATH_ABS"
   197|
   198|      - name: Get simulator info
   199|        id: sim
   200|        run: |
   201|          # Get the booted simulator
   202|          SIM_INFO=$(xcrun simctl list devices booted -j | python3 -c "
   203|          import json, sys
   204|          data = json.load(sys.stdin)
   205|          for runtime, devices in data['devices'].items():
   206|              for d in devices:
   207|                  if d['state'] == 'Booted' and 'iPhone' in d['name']:
   208|                      print(json.dumps({'udid': d['udid'], 'name': d['name'], 'runtime': runtime}))
   209|                      sys.exit(0)
   210|          # Fallback: any booted device
   211|          for runtime, devices in data['devices'].items():
   212|              for d in devices:
   213|                  if d['state'] == 'Booted':
   214|                      print(json.dumps({'udid': d['udid'], 'name': d['name'], 'runtime': runtime}))
   215|                      sys.exit(0)
   216|          ")
   217|          if [ -z "$SIM_INFO" ]; then
   218|            echo "::error::No booted simulator found"
   219|            xcrun simctl list devices booted
   220|            exit 1
   221|          fi
   222|          SIM_ID=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['udid'])")
   223|          SIM_NAME=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['name'])")
   224|          SIM_RUNTIME=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['runtime'])")
   225|          IOS_VERSION=$(echo "$SIM_RUNTIME" | sed 's/.*iOS-//')
   226|          echo "sim_id=$SIM_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   227|          echo "sim_name=$SIM_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   228|          echo "ios_version=$IOS_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   229|          echo "Booted simulator: $SIM_NAME (iOS $IOS_VERSION, UDID: $SIM_ID)"
   230|
   231|      - name: Capture launch screenshot
   232|        run: |
   233|          sleep 5
   234|          xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshot-01-launch.png
   235|          echo "Launch screenshot saved"
   236|
   237|      - name: Capture simulator system log
   238|        run: |
   239|          xcrun simctl spawn booted log show --last 2m > simulator-log.txt 2>&1 || true
   240|
   241|      - name: Install Maestro
   242|        run: |
   243|          curl -Ls "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash
   244|          echo "$HOME/.maestro/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
   245|          maestro --version
   246|
   247|      - name: Run Maestro launch test (no auth required)
   248|        id: maestro-launch
   249|        working-directory: expo
   250|        continue-on-error: true
   251|        run: |
   252|          maestro test .maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml --format junit --output maestro-launch-results.xml 2>&1 | tee maestro-launch.log
   253|          echo "Maestro launch test completed"
   254|
   255|      - name: Run full 20-step chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)
   256|        id: maestro-chat
   257|        working-directory: expo
   258|        env:
   259|          OWNER_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OWNER_PASSWORD }}
   260|        continue-on-error: true
   261|        run: |
   262|          if [ -z "$OWNER_PASSWORD" ] && [ "${{ github.event.inputs.run_full_qa }}" != "true" ]; then
   263|            echo "OWNER_PASSWORD secret not set — full 20-step chat QA skipped"
   264|            echo "To enable: add OWNER_PASSWORD as a GitHub repository secret"
   265|            echo "result=skipped" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   266|            exit 0
   267|          fi
   268|          maestro test .maestro/ivx-chat-full-qa.yaml --format junit --output maestro-chat-results.xml 2>&1 | tee maestro-chat.log
   269|          echo "result=completed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   270|
   271|      - name: Take post-test screenshot
   272|        run: |
   273|          xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshot-02-post-test.png || true
   274|
   275|      - name: Get simulator runtime info
   276|        if: always()
   277|        run: |
   278|          xcrun simctl list devices -j | python3 -c "
   279|          import json, sys
   280|          data = json.load(sys.stdin)
   281|          for runtime, devices in data['devices'].items():
   282|              for d in devices:
   283|                  if d['udid'] == '${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_id }}':
   284|                      print(f\"Device: {d['name']}\")
   285|                      print(f\"State: {d['state']}\")
   286|                      print(f\"Runtime: {runtime}\")
   287|          " > simulator-info.txt 2>&1 || true
   288|
   289|      - name: Shutdown simulator
   290|        if: always()
   291|        run: |
   292|          xcrun simctl shutdown all 2>/dev/null || true
   293|
   294|      - name: Upload all artifacts
   295|        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
   296|        if: always()
   297|        with:
   298|          name: ios-simulator-qa-${{ github.sha }}
   299|          path: |
   300|            screenshot-*.png
   301|            simulator-log.txt
   302|            simulator-info.txt
   303|            expo/expo-build.log
   304|            expo/maestro-launch-results.xml
   305|            expo/maestro-launch.log
   306|            expo/maestro-chat-results.xml
   307|            expo/maestro-chat.log
   308|          retention-days: 30
   309|
   310|      - name: Generate QA summary
   311|        if: always()
   312|        run: |
   313|          echo "## iOS Simulator QA Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   314|          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   315|          echo "| Item | Value |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   316|          echo "| --- | --- |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   317|          echo "| Commit SHA | \`${{ github.sha }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   318|          echo "| Simulator | ${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_name }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   319|          echo "| iOS Version | ${{ steps.sim.outputs.ios_version }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   320|          echo "| Build Status | \`${{ steps.build.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   321|          echo "| Maestro Launch | \`${{ steps.maestro-launch.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   322|          echo "| Maestro Chat QA | \`${{ steps.maestro-chat.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   323|          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   324|          echo "### Artifacts" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   325|          echo "- Screenshots: \`screenshot-01-launch.png\`, \`screenshot-02-post-test.png\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   326|          echo "- Build log: \`expo/expo-build.log\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   327|          echo "- Simulator logs: \`simulator-log.txt\`, \`simulator-info.txt\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
